data.long_meaning: The name Dragoslav is derived from the Slavic elements 'drag' meaning 'rad' or 'glorious' and 'slav' meaning 'slave of God'. This name conveys a sense of being a devoted servant of the divine. The name Dragoslav carries the meaning “Rad, glorious slave of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dragoslav usually hope their child will grow to embody rad, glorious slave of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: דרגוסלב
in_hebrew.meaning: דר = ראש, ג = תכשיט, ס = יד, ל = פנים, ב = כלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם דרגוסלב נוצר מהמילים 'דר' שמשמעותה 'ראש', 'ג' שמשמעותה 'תכשיט', 'ס' שמשמעותה 'יד', 'ל' שמשמעותה 'פנים', ו'ב' שמשמעותה 'כלי'. במסורת הנוצרית, השם הזה עשוי לסמל ראשות, אדיבות, יזיעה, פנים נכונות והתמדה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם דרגוסלב עשוי להיות ראשי תיבות של 'דרג' - ראש, 'סלב' - שבז, למשל.

in_greek.name: Δραγόςλαβ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Δραγόςλαβ σχηματίστηκε από τους τύπους δράγος, που σημαίνει 'δράω' και λαβ, που σημαίνει 'λαβέ'. Στην αρχαία ελληνική, ο όρος δράγος σχετίζεται με την ιδέα της δράσης και της δραστηριότητας. Σε μια μεταφρασμένη μορφή, ο όρος αυτός μπορεί να σχετιστεί με την έννοια της δραστηριότητας, της δράσης και της ενεργούς κίνησης. Στην κουλτούρα των πρώτων Χριστιανών, το όνομα Δραγόςλαβ μπορεί να θεωρηθεί ως μια προσπάθεια να περιγράψει την πνευματική δραστηριότητα και την ενεργή συμμετοχή στον πνευματικό κόσμο.

in_latin.name: Dragoslavus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dragoslavus est compositum ex partibus 'Drago', quod significat 'actio', 'actus', et 'slavus', quod significat 'servus'. In contextu Ecclesiae Christianae, nomen Dragoslavus potest esse interpretatum 'servus actionis', 'servus actus', vel 'servus laboris'. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen Dragoslavus potest esse interpretatum 'servus Dei', 'servus evangelii', vel 'servus ecclesiae'.

in_english.name: Dragoslav
in_english.meaning: Dragon-like or courageous, glorious, slavish or servile
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dragoslav is derived from the Old Church Slavonic words 'dragos' meaning 'dragon-like' or 'courageous' and 'slav' meaning 'glorious' or 'slavish'. In the Christian tradition, the name Dragoslav may symbolize courage, glory, servitude, and loyalty. In the context of early Christianity, the name Dragoslav may be seen as a representation of a faithful servant of God, a champion of the faith, or a defender of the Church.

Dragoslav means "slave of God," implying a deep commitment and submission to the divine will. This name serves as a constant reminder to live a life in service of God and to strive towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dragoslav means "beloved of the slaves of God" or "servant of the beloved God" in Old Slavic. It is a name that evokes a sense of devotion and humility, reflecting the Christian belief in serving and loving God above all else.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dragoslav was a Serbian prince in the 14th century. The name Dragoslav carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
